material_defects.finding: The n=12 family-disjoint replication reserve is frozen and cannot retune, but neither the T1 prereg nor the earlier untouched-population freeze defines an explicit T1R statistical support/failure rule. The text only says to import primary intervention/site/scale/metric thresholds. This does not specify whether T1R uses one or both sign tests, Holm correction, how zeros are treated, its natural-trajectory gate/denominator, or what exact label constitutes replicated support.
material_defects.required_repair: Before any ReplayResidual scientific outcome, create a lineage-only successor prereg with identical model, populations, controls, development/confirmation rules, endpoints, thresholds and operating-point contract, changing only the T1R decision section. Freeze an explicit n=12 independent-family rule, including natural-trajectory handling/all12 denominator, exact co-primary tests and multiplicity if inferential, zero/tie handling, effect/task-success/valid-action guards, support/null/inconclusive labels, and a no-rescue clause. Demonstrate that the chosen rule is attainable at n=12. No population or primary threshold may change.
material_defects.why_material: T1R is part of the stated minimum paper ladder. Leaving its decision rule unspecified until after the n=20 primary is observed creates a post-outcome researcher degree of freedom and can turn replication into a selectively interpreted robustness check.

non_material_recommendation: For strongest NeurIPS/ICLR framing, report a mechanically defined same-first-action/different-later-commitment subset/stratum if enough frozen families naturally instantiate it, but do not filter the all20 primary population or make this a post-outcome rescue. The current LPA plus NEXT_ACTION_PRESERVED_LATE_NULL already provides a strong first-action-copying defense.
positive_findings: Primary LPA excludes action1 and requires reference pre-action world-state hashes, blocking immediate-action copying and different-route inflation.
One-shot intervention and persistent same-KV/session semantics are explicit and fail closed on reinjection or prefix rebuild.
Development operating-point selection is global and frozen before confirmation; no per-family or confirmation tuning.
All20 confirmation denominator is conservative; unqualified/unconstructible families cannot become sign successes.
The n=20 two-test Holm design is statistically attainable and all main effect/competence guards are prospectively frozen.

n12_one_sided_sign.note: If a future repaired T1R uses the same two one-sided sign tests with Holm .05, 10/12 positive on both yields p=0.019287... and is attainable; 9/12 is not nominally <.05. This is an audit example, not a mandated repair choice.

n20_one_sided_sign.note: For two similar co-primary p-values under Holm FWER .05, 15/20 positive is sufficient whereas 14/20 is not.
